state.description: GPC will rebuild the Line Creek 230kV substation as breaker and a half configuration and connect the Morrow - Yates 230kV line and the Union City - Yates 230kV White line into Line Creek. For the Union City - Yates 230kV Black line, terminate the line from the Yates side into Shugart Farms, and the line from the Union City side into Line Creek. Build two short lines from Line Creek to Shugart Farm

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
